import math
import heapq


class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y


class Edge:
    def __init__(self, node1, node2, x1, y1, x2, y2):
        self.node1 = node1
        self.node2 = node2
        self.x1 = x1
        self.y1 = y1
        self.x2 = x2
        self.y2 = y2

    def get_distance(self):
        return math.sqrt((self.x2 - self.x1) * (self.x2 - self.x1) + (self.y2 - self.y1) * (self.y2 - self.y1))

    def __lt__(self, other):
        if self.get_distance() < other.get_distance():
            return True
        return False


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx])
    idx += 1
    p = [None] * n
    for i in range(n):
        a = float(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        b = float(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        p[i] = Point(a, b)
    pq = []
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            edge = Edge(i, j, p[i].x, p[i].y, p[j].x, p[j].y)
            heapq.heappush(pq, edge)
    added = [False] * n
    total = 0
    temp = heapq.heappop(pq)
    added[temp.node1] = True
    added[temp.node2] = True
    total += temp.get_distance()
    found = False
    temp_list = []
    while len(pq) > 0 and not found:
        temp2 = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if (added[temp2.node1] and not added[temp2.node2]) or (not added[temp2.node1] and added[temp2.node2]):
            added[temp2.node1] = True
            added[temp2.node2] = True
            total += temp2.get_distance()
            pq.extend(temp_list)
            heapq.heapify(pq)
            temp_list = []
        elif not added[temp2.node1] and not added[temp2.node2]:
            temp_list.append(temp2)
    print("%.2f" % total)

import sys
import heapq


class Graph:
    DIM = 1000

    def __init__(self):
        self.adj = [None] * Graph.DIM
        self.color = [0] * Graph.DIM
        self.parent = [-1] * Graph.DIM
        self.start_time = [-1] * Graph.DIM
        self.finish_time = [-1] * Graph.DIM
        self.time = 0

    def transpose(self):
        transposed = Graph()
        i = 0
        while self.adj[i] is not None:
            transposed.adj[i] = []
            i += 1
        i = 0
        while self.adj[i] is not None:
            for node in self.adj[i]:
                transposed.adj[node].append(i)
            i += 1
        return transposed

    def depth_first_search(self, fst, snd):
        for i in range(Graph.DIM):
            self.color[i] = 0
            self.parent[i] = -1
            self.start_time[i] = -1
            self.finish_time[i] = -1
        self.time = 0
        for source in fst:
            if self.color[source] == 0:
                self.depth_first_visit(source, snd)

    def depth_first_visit(self, source, snd):
        self.color[source] = 1
        self.time += 1
        self.start_time[source] = self.time
        for node in self.adj[source]:
            if self.color[node] == 0:
                self.parent[node] = source
                self.depth_first_visit(node, snd)
        self.color[source] = 2
        self.time += 1
        self.finish_time[source] = self.time
        snd.insert(0, source)

    def find_values(self, value, vtr):
        fila = []
        i = 0
        while self.adj[i] is not None:
            if vtr[i] == value:
                heapq.heappush(fila, i)
            i += 1
        return fila

    def make_tree(self, tree, value):
        if value != -1:
            tree.append(value)
        fila = self.find_values(value, self.parent)
        while fila:
            new_value = heapq.heappop(fila)
            self.make_tree(tree, new_value)

    def build_tree_forest(self):
        tree = [None] * Graph.DIM
        i = 0
        while self.adj[i] is not None:
            if self.parent[i] == -1:
                aux = 0
                j = 0
                while tree[j] is not None:
                    aux += 1
                    j += 1
                tree[aux] = []
                self.make_tree(tree[aux], i)
            i += 1
        return tree


def main():
    sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
    dados = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(dados)
    n_cenarios = int(next(it))
    for i in range(n_cenarios):
        fst = []
        snd = []
        sociologia = Graph()
        n_alunos = int(next(it))
        for j in range(n_alunos):
            sociologia.adj[j] = []
            fst.append(j)
        for j in range(n_alunos):
            aluno = int(next(it))
            n_amigos = int(next(it))
            for k in range(n_amigos):
                sociologia.adj[aluno - 1].append(int(next(it)) - 1)
        sociologia.depth_first_search(fst, snd)
        sociologia_t = sociologia.transpose()
        fst = []
        sociologia_t.depth_first_search(snd, fst)
        groups = sociologia_t.build_tree_forest()
        count = 0
        n_groups = 0
        n_elem_out = 0
        print("Caso #%d" % (i + 1))
        j = 0
        while groups[j] is not None:
            for elemento in groups[j]:
                count += 1
            if count >= 4:
                n_groups += 1
            else:
                n_elem_out += count
            count = 0
            j += 1
        print("%d %d" % (n_groups, n_elem_out))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            nodes[u + 1][v].visited = True
            nodes[u + 1][v].distance = nodes[u][v].distance + 1
        if u > 0 and not nodes[u - 1][v].visited:
            x.append(u - 1)
            y.append(v)
            nodes[u - 1][v].visited = True
            nodes[u - 1][v].distance = nodes[u][v].distance + 1
